scripts.build:cloudflare: node scripts/generate-seo-forecasts.mjs && node scripts/generate-cloudflare-worker.mjs && next build
scripts.preview:cloudflare: ORIVANE_SKIP_SEO_REFRESH=1 npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages dev out --env preview --compatibility-date=2026-07-01
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=orivane-market-intelligence
scripts.deploy:cloudflare:all: npm run deploy:cloudflare && npm run deploy:favorite-optimizer
scripts.test:security: node scripts/generate-cloudflare-worker.mjs && vitest run tests/cloudflare-auth.test.ts tests/cloudflare-runtime.test.ts components/account-isolation.test.tsx lib/private-storage.test.ts lib/api-auth.test.ts
